description: This file contains utility functions for resolving items such as notes, notebooks, tags, and related data within the Notesnook project. It includes functions for fetching related data from a database, processing relations, and preparing data structures with metadata like date edited and locked status.

classes.name: NotebooksWithDateEdited
classes.description: Type alias for notebooks with associated latest edit date.

classes.name: TagsWithDateEdited
classes.description: Type alias for tags with associated latest edit date.

classes.name: NoteResolvedData
classes.description: Type describing the structure of resolved note data including related notebooks, tags, reminders, color, attachments, and lock status.

methods.name: withDateEdited
methods.description: Calculates the latest date edited or modified among a list of items and returns the items with this date.

methods.name: resolveItems
methods.description: Resolves a list of item IDs to their detailed data based on item type (note, notebook, tag).

methods.name: resolveNotes
methods.description: Fetches and compiles related data for note IDs, including notebooks, tags, colors, reminders, attachments, and lock status.

methods.name: isNoteResolvedData
methods.description: Type guard to check if a data object conforms to the NoteResolvedData structure.
